Card Q&A.a: No. You can either suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, regardless of DP, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. You can't mix and match.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to suspend both 1 of my opponent's Digimon, and 2 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, this card's effect allows you to pick 1 Digimon and suspend it, regardless of DP.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less, and no other Digimon?

Effect: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
